Independent Codex review by the non-author review subagent (/root/ops038_review). I did not write this implementation or its tests. This is an attributable independent review in the PR conversation, not a separate-account formal GitHub approval.

Verdict: APPROVE. No P1/P2 findings for head 94ae4a2be26e0d44440ad74536869485ab76a141 against integration base 01bc90b0ad3fc28a73aa8121eb30f28f19eadfca. I fetched the branch, detached my separate 038-review worktree at that exact head, and reverified the live PR head/base before posting.

Source review:
- Automatic presentation is guarded by a won first recovery of code id31, previous progress without31, and existing final-pair photo-ending eligibility. Operation30 cannot trigger it. The old ids12/13 recovery branch is unchanged.
- The existing 027 photo-wall Plate renderer and best-frame selection are reused. Endings.resolve, the photo-ending rule module, and simulation files are byte-identical to the base.
- The only saved addition is an optional validated boolean. Missing-field completed-pair saves and explicit seen=true saves boot normally with manual replay access; new-campaign reset clears the marker. The off switch disables new presentation/replay and retains recorded true state.
- Exactly two data-table placeholder lines use recorded facts or fixed missing-fact fallbacks. Credits reuses the existing frontend and returns to unobscured Operations.

Fresh independent Windows Godot4.6.3 results on this exact head (all exit0, FAILURES0):
| Check | Checks | Raw log under ../042-review-evidence/ |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Import | clean | final94-import.log |
| Core | 836 | final94-core.log |
| finale_provisional_tests / FINALE | 28 | final94-unit.log |
| finale_provisional_ui_tests headless / FINALE UI | 246 | final94-ui.log |
| finale_provisional_ui_tests native Compatibility / FINALE UI | 255, including9 PNG checks | final94-native-ui.log |
| endings_photo_tests / PHOTO ENDINGS | 92 | final94-photo-endings.log |
| endings_photo_ui_tests native / PHOTO ENDINGS UI | 42 | final94-native-photo-endings.log |
| fix2_save_tests / FIX2 SAVE | 12 | final94-fix2-save.log |
| save_profiles_tests / SAVE PROFILES | 68 plus3 cold-load checks | final94-profiles.log |
| save_profiles_ui_tests native only / SAVE PROFILES UI | 168 | final94-native-profiles.log |
| back_exit_tests / BACK EXIT | 17 | final94-back-exit.log |

Actual command forms:
- Import: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/toolchain/win/headless.ps1 -Action Import -Isolate -UserDataRoot ABSOLUTE_UNIQUE_ROOT -Log ../042-review-evidence/final94-import.log
- Core: the same helper with -Action Core.
- Named headless checks: the same helper with -Action Script -Script SCRIPT_NAME -Prefix REGISTERED_PREFIX. Script names/prefixes and exact log names are in the table. Every run used its own absolute isolated root named final94-CHECK-userdata.
- Native checks: dot-source scripts/toolchain/win/common.ps1; Invoke-GodotLogged with --path GAME_DIR --rendering-method gl_compatibility --script res://tests/SCRIPT_NAME.gd, separate absolute isolated roots and the listed logs; Test-GodotLog with the registered prefix. All native strict validators returned Problems:[].
- Native finale used SIRENS_042_CAPTURE_DIR pointing to ../042-review-evidence/final94-captures (absolute). I visually inspected all9 final-head PNGs across2520x1080,2184x1968 and960x432. Footer/replay controls remain visible; the narrow fallback's fact text wraps in the existing scroll area.
- python scripts/toolchain/check-suites.py:258 suites,0 errors,0 warnings. git diff --check passed. Final source/test working-tree diff is empty; only generated local import metadata exists. No manual tracked-source/test edits or commits were made in the review worktree.

Limits: the UI tests use controlled progress fixtures, an ordinary camera exposure/physical recovery boundary, and engine-injected touch/Android Back. They are not a complete or blind campaign playthrough. No physical Android ergonomics, phone/APK, or full local matrix testing. The reused Plate has no tap/enlarge interaction; this review does not claim one. Earlier candidate runs remain separately named and are not counted as final94 evidence. Hosted guidance/game-smoke remains the required merge gate; this review does not assert its completion.
